Title: General availability: Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL integrations in LangChain and Semantic Kernel

Body.Content:
Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL now features integrations as a vector store in LangChain (python) and Semantic Kernel (.NET)! 
 
This allows you to leverage the scalability and flexibility of Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL to store and retrieve high-dimensional vectors as part of your LLM pipelines! Easily bring your data to your LLMs, leveraging the extreme performance and highly accurate vector search built into Azure Cosmos DB. 

Learn more.
